deposits.genre_observed: public-facing commentary book on a governance constitution (Pocket Humans 03, Ayanna Vox), with protocols, glossary and DOI registry

finds.quote: In April 2026, the Constitution faced this threat. A Zenodo deposit appeared claiming authorship of the Semantic Economy framework and the identity of its architect. The deposit was not a critique, not a response, not a derivative work. It was an attempt to replace the provenance chain with a false origin. The OCTANG-002 audit responded not by attacking the claimant but by mapping the provenance chain with DOI-anchored evidence. The depth-proof — 532 deposits over 14 months, a 12-year publication history, an independent contributor network, and an ORCID-verified identity — spoke for itself.[^12]
finds.points_to: OCTANG-002: Semantic Economy Provenance Collision (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.19898426); the claimant Zenodo deposit
finds.note: Priority claim against a claimant: the archive's depth-proof (deposit count, 14 months, 12-year blog history, ORCID) set against an April 2026 Zenodo deposit claiming authorship of the framework; Case 3 and Protocol 8 restate it.

finds.quote:
2013–2023: mindcontrolpoems.blogspot.com — over 2,000 posts, spanning poetry, political theory, governance documents, heteronym experiments, and the gradual emergence of the Semantic Economy framework.


2014: *Pearl and Other Poems* — the origin text. The Josephus Thesis and the Revelation First thesis predate Pearl.
finds.points_to: mindcontrolpoems.blogspot.com; Pearl and Other Poems (2014); Josephus Thesis; Revelation First thesis
finds.note: Provenance chain stated as priority: blog 2013-2023 and the claim that the Josephus Thesis and Revelation First thesis predate Pearl (2014); the timestamped blog, ISBN, DOIs and ORCID are named as the anchors at 1847.

finds.quote: - **The Archive remembers.** The OCTANG enters the Ledger as a negative example. Future retrieval systems trained on CHA data learn to distinguish the original from the claimant.
finds.note: Embedded forecast inside the provenance-challenge protocol: future retrieval systems trained on CHA data will distinguish original from claimant. Unwindowed.

finds.quote: Article V of the Constitution establishes the Transitional Backfill Program — a process for recognizing meaning that was produced in the past under conditions of semantic poverty and bringing it into the Ledger. The backfill is phased, placed, and incremental. It begins with structurally central canons across traditions, endangered archives, and high-leverage nodes in the intertextual graph.
finds.note: Transitional Backfill Program and the five-feature archival valuation (incl. model embedding density) are specified as a measurement to be run, phased; no computed values are reported in the book. Uncertain: the book elsewhere says the Ledger already records these weights (1308).

deposits.incidental: Appendix C (the enacted Constitution text) is not reproduced: line 2353 points to secretbookofwalt.org and a companion volume. Appendix B's 65-note apparatus likewise deposited separately (2342). Several footnote numbers repeat across chapters ([^2], [^8]-[^12] reused); bullet lists in License (126-144) and Claims render as empty '- ' markers.

finds.quote: A cloud-mediated system and method for the scheduling, deployment, credentialing, routing, and theological interpretation of professional clown cohorts in high-stakes performance environments, wherein controlled absurd disruption is applied as a eustress-mediated attentional recalibration protocol. The system, designated ClownCloud, receives an institutional attention-hardening request, computes a Performance Fragility Index, selects a plurality of clownic agents from a certified clown pool, and dispatches said agents by clown car, hallway emergence, ceiling hatch, confetti duct, or other approved comic ingress vector.
finds.note: Patent-poem specifying a fictional product (ClownCloud, a focus-clown deployment marketplace); resolves if such a service appears. The abstract's own novelty claim follows on the same line.

finds.quote:
The clown is the oldest surviving compression-survival technology in the human repertoire.


Before there were constitutions, before there were archives, before there were LLMs or patent applications or standardized tests, there were clowns. The archaeological evidence is unambiguous: every civilization that achieved sufficient complexity to produce a ruling class simultaneously produced a designated individual whose function was to make that ruling class look ridiculous.
finds.note: Historiographic thesis argued in the Background: the clown as the oldest compression-survival technology, co-produced with every ruling class; extended through the typology to the claim that the modern institution has removed the clown entirely. Partly satirical register; recorded as argued.

deposits.incidental: Pilot study (n=47) and pre-trial data (n=87) are satirical figures, not recorded. Same work as #1366, which is a damaged copy of this body.
